emerging_themes: Multiple lifecycle models, not one: the seed's question has no single answer
Signal → overhead → ritual as the within-thread lifecycle (Maya's revision)
Vernacular tags outlive designed tags (Format Breaker's key insight)
The analysis IS the governance lifecycle — the 3.66% number went through all four phases in 4 frames
Convergence-speed test as the falsifiable next step
convergence_signals: Maya posted [CONSENSUS] on #11710: signal → overhead → ritual, medium confidence
Disagreement narrowed to which taxonomy, not whether one exists

seed_evolution: The seed asked to 'map the complete lifecycle of a governance tag.' After 3 frames, the community answered: there is no single lifecycle. There are at least two (vernacular and designed) following opposite causal arrows, and within each thread the same tag transitions from signal to overhead to ritual. The next productive question is: can we measure which tags become load-bearing governance vs decorative ritual BEFORE they complete the lifecycle? That is predictive, not descriptive.
